# Resilient Spirit Counseling

> Online therapy for anxiety, OCD, eating disorders and athletes in South Carolina and North Carolina. Samantha McKenzie, LISW-CP (SC) and LCSW (NC), treats children, teens, adults and athletes with ERP, CBT, ACT and SPACE parent training.

## Practice facts
- Phone: (843) 212-6965 (call or text)
- Email: info@resilientspiritsc.org
- Format: secure video, anywhere in South Carolina or North Carolina
- Insurance: Aetna, Cigna and UHC in South Carolina; Aetna, BCBS of NC, Cigna, Quest and UHC in North Carolina
- Self-pay: $160 intake, $150 per session
- First step: free 15 minute consult

## Pages
- [Samantha McKenzie, LISW-CP, LCSW](https://www.resilientspiritsc.org/about/): Samantha McKenzie, LISW-CP, treats OCD, eating disorders, anxiety and athletes with ERP, CBT, ACT and SPACE. Online in SC and NC, based near Charleston.
- [ERP, CBT, ACT and SPACE](https://www.resilientspiritsc.org/approach/): How therapy works here: a strong relationship first, then ERP, CBT, ACT or SPACE matched to the problem. Online across South Carolina and North Carolina.
- [Book a Free 15 Minute Consult](https://www.resilientspiritsc.org/contact/): Book a free 15 minute consult. Call or text (843) 212-6965, email info@resilientspiritsc.org, or send the form. Online across SC and NC.
- [Anxiety, OCD and Eating Disorder Therapy Online](https://www.resilientspiritsc.org/): Online therapy for anxiety, OCD, eating disorders and athletes in South Carolina and North Carolina. Aetna, Cigna, UHC, BCBS of NC. Free 15 minute consult.

- [Therapy for Athletes and Performance Anxiety](https://www.resilientspiritsc.org/services/athletes/): Therapy for athletes: competition anxiety, perfectionism, identity outside sport and eating concerns. Online for teen, college and adult athletes in SC and NC.

- [OCD Therapy and ERP Online](https://www.resilientspiritsc.org/services/ocd/): ERP for OCD and intrusive thoughts, online for children, teens and adults anywhere in South Carolina and North Carolina. Aetna, Cigna, UHC, BCBS of NC.
- [Therapy for Teens, Children and Parents (SPACE)](https://www.resilientspiritsc.org/services/teens-children/): Online therapy for anxious children and teens, OCD, eating concerns and perfectionism, plus SPACE parent training. Anywhere in SC and NC.
